bugClass.title: Notification quiet hours also block work launches
bugClass.cause: A quiet-hour policy intended to suppress user-facing notifications is also applied to launching or scheduling work, so eligible jobs are deferred during that window. This can happen through a shared quiet-hours predicate or a separate inline time-window check in a work queue.
bugClass.criteria: Classify another site when a notification or messaging quiet-hours rule gates automatic work launch, queue processing, or job scheduling. Either shared notification quiet-hour logic or an independent inline time-window check in the work path is sufficient. Do not classify notification suppression alone.
